verdict.rationale: stagewise is documented as a standalone desktop IDE whose agents run locally across your workspaces, with parallel local agent sessions and a setting to keep the app awake while agents work. Nothing documents background execution of tasks in an isolated cloud environment. The 'stagewise Cloud' self-hosting mention does not describe cloud task execution, and a community comment notes that agents run directly on the host rather than sandboxed.

support.subject: As a developer, I can delegate longer-running coding tasks to run in the background in an isolated cloud environment
